scripts.prepare:assets: npm run prepare:scene && npm run prepare:lighting && npm run prepare:bounce && npm run prepare:destruction
scripts.build: npm run build:kernel && npm run check && vite build
scripts.prepare:scene: python3 tools/assets/compile_medieval.py && python3 tools/assets/compile_catalog.py && python3 tools/assets/compile_decals.py && python3 tools/assets/compile_uv1.py && python3 tools/assets/compile_surface_decals.py && python3 tools/assets/compile_sky.py && tsx tools/assets/compile-ibl.ts && python3 tools/assets/compile_water.py
scripts.prepare:lighting: tsx tools/assets/compile-atmosphere.ts && tsx tools/assets/compile-ibl.ts --manifest "$AETHYRFORGE_LIGHTING_OUTPUT/lighting-environments.json" --look "$AETHYRFORGE_PRIVATE_ASSETS/scene-look.json" && tsx tools/assets/link-lighting.ts
